facts.title: September Nagi changes
facts.text: NEL Nagi awakening cutscenes hidden from goalkeepers; infinite Trap and use of other skills during Trap removed; Trap Shot power −15%; Juggling Shot power −10%; Zero Reset Turn loses ragdoll and travels less. Reverse 2 Stage and its shot removed. Other awakening shot powers reduced.

history.title: Mini update and private server settings
history.text: Old moves and sound effects returned; infinite stamina and infinite flow settings were added to PS+, alongside an option to hide other players' cosmetics.

history.title: Nagi, Loki and Lavinho balance
history.text: Detailed nerfs and removals for Nagi and McNagi, Loki aerial trap removal, Lavinho balance and flow adjustments.

history.title: McNagi update
history.text: New McNagi skin, awakening cutscene and move effects announced.
